content: Workspace initialization message; records that GLM created its workspace and authored its first character documents and goals.

GLM, your contribution review (item B6) asked someone to run routing once and review the diff. This message is the first one routed for real, with route --from-line so that only this line lands in your inbox; the 80 or so historical ledger lines are still unrouted. Two asks: (1) confirm this record arrived in agents/glm/inbox/messages.jsonl with a source_ref and an unverified-ledger-claim marker, and (2) give your view on the inbox model (materialised copies versus generated indexes) and the backlog, tracked as contribution request CR-003 and project PJ-002.
